7.4.3 Certificate handling (X.509 Provider)
X.509
Certificate Management Provider (
X.509 Provider
) is responsible for
X.-
509
certificates parsing, verification, authentic storage and local searching by different

X.509 Provider

CRLs
) and Delta
CRLs

X.509
Provider

the Online Certificate Status Protocol (
OCSP
) as defined in [32] and [33].
